easing.$description: Easing curves in W3C DTCG cubicBezier format

standard.$description: Standard easing for most animations. M3: standard, Fluent: decelerate, Carbon: standard

emphasized.$description: Single-bezier APPROXIMATION of M3 emphasized. Use emphasized-path for exact M3 behavior on supporting platforms.

emphasized-path.$description: Exact M3 emphasized easing as two-segment cubic bezier path. Use with Android PathInterpolator or custom JS implementation.

emphasized-linear.$description: CSS linear() function for exact M3 emphasized easing. Requires modern browser support (Chrome 113+, Safari 17.2+).

emphasized-decelerate.$description: For elements ENTERING the screen. Fast start, gentle settle. M3: emphasized-decelerate

emphasized-accelerate.$description: For elements EXITING the screen. Slow start, fast exit. M3: emphasized-accelerate

standard-decelerate.$description: Simple deceleration for basic entrances. M3: standard-decelerate

standard-accelerate.$description: Simple acceleration for basic exits. M3: standard-accelerate

linear.$description: Linear motion for continuous animations (spinners, progress). All systems: linear

ease-in-out-gentle.$description: Gentle ease-in-out for calming, relaxed animations

ease-in-out-slow.$description: Slow ease-in-out for mysterious, lingering animations

bounce-out.$description: Overshoot easing that simulates bounce without spring physics

spring.$description: M3 spring physics. See tokens/spring.tokens.json for the canonical source. Spatial springs (damping 0.9) allow overshoot for position/scale/rotation. Effects springs (damping 1.0) are critically damped for opacity/color.

spatial.$description: M3 fast spatial spring. Position, scale, rotation for small elements.

effects.$description: M3 fast effects spring. Opacity, color for small elements.

spatial.$description: M3 default spatial spring. Position, scale, rotation for standard UI.

effects.$description: M3 default effects spring. Opacity, color for standard UI.

spatial.$description: M3 slow spatial spring. Position, scale, rotation for large elements.

effects.$description: M3 slow effects spring. Opacity, color for large elements.

legacy.$description: DEPRECATED: Use M3 springs (fast/default/slow × spatial/effects). These legacy tokens are kept for backward compatibility.

bouncy.$description: Custom bouncy spring for playful overshoot.

cross-reference.$description: Equivalent curves in other design systems

apple-default.$description: Apple HIG default ease (ease-in-out). Used for most UI transitions.

apple-ease-in.$description: Apple HIG ease-in. Elements leaving view or accelerating.

apple-ease-out.$description: Apple HIG ease-out. Elements entering view or decelerating.

apple-spring.$description: Apple HIG spring animation. Fluid, natural motion for iOS/macOS.
